data.title: Remittances to Uzbekistan Rise 8.9% to $15.17 Billion in Nine Months - The Times Of Central Asia
data.content:
In the first half of 2026, remittances from Russia rose 8.8% even as Uzbek citizens made 13.2% fewer trips to Russia for work than a year earlier. They listed work as their reason for entering Russia on about 1.18 million occasions. A person who crossed the border several times for work was counted each time. [...] Russia’s Interior Ministry said more than 260,000 foreign nationals and stateless people were barred from entering Russia from January through August 2026, up 75.8% from the same period in 2025. The ministry gave no separate figure for Uzbek citizens. [...] Uzbekistan is seeking to expand employment opportunities for its citizens in other countries. In the first half of 2026, remittances from the United Kingdom rose by 62% year on year, those from European Union countries by 27%, and those from the United States by 19%. These labor markets still employ far fewer Uzbek citizens than Russia does.
